# VoxeLibre Wool Stairs & Slabs (`mcl_wool_stairs`)

A small mod that adds wool stairs and slabs for each wool color, inspired by the upcoming MC drop.
Designed for VoxeLibre and Mineclonia.

## Features

### Nodes

* Wool Stairs (white, grey, silver, black, red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta, orange, purple, brown, pink, lime, light blue)
* Wool Slabs (white, grey, silver, black, red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta, orange, purple, brown, pink, lime, light blue)

### Crafting

* Wool stairs and slabs can be crafted from their corresponding wool blocks.
* White wool stairs and slabs can be recolored using dyes.

*ChatGPT was used as assistance while coding. All AI-generated code is understood by me as well.*
